info.title: Secure DNS & WHOIS API
info.description: Private, production-grade API for DNS lookups, reverse DNS, WHOIS queries, ping, traceroute, HTTP headers, DNS recon, port scanning, PageSpeed Insights, DNS propagation, tech stack detection, MTR analysis, SSL inspection, Subnet/CIDR calc, Robots.txt parsing, Email Security, ASN Lookup, DNSBL checker, and IPv6 readiness validation. Authenticate with X-API-Key header.

get.description: Resolve DNS records for a single domain.

post.description: Resolve DNS records for multiple domains in parallel.

get.description: Look up hostnames for an IP address via PTR records.
Query WHOIS data for a domain.

post.description: Query WHOIS data for multiple domains in parallel.

get.description: Check host reachability and measure latency via ICMP ping.
Trace the network path to a host, revealing ISP/CDN hops.
Retrieve HTTP response headers for a target (curl -I). Infers tech stack, CDN, and checks security headers.

post.description: Enumerate all DNS record types, attempt zone transfer, and brute-force subdomains.

get.description: Quick DNS recon for a domain (all record types, no subdomain brute-force).
Scan TCP ports on a host. Defaults to top 20 common ports.

post.description: Scan TCP ports on multiple hosts in parallel.

get.description: Run Google Lighthouse performance analysis on a URL. Returns Core Web Vitals, performance score, and key audits.
Check DNS record propagation across multiple global DNS servers.

Probe common paths and hidden directories.
